Name: Alex Cooks Salmon in the Dishwasher
Author: strawhatwem
Description:
I just think Alex would do this. 

How to trigger: reach 5 Hearts with Alex and enter his house between 5 PM and 7 PM.

Disclaimer: do not do this yourself. It's not safe. It can give you food poisoning. Don't.

There is i18n support! Let me know if you'd like to translate this silliness.
